name: Agent pre-payment checks compared
description: Checks a tool's own page says it runs before an agent pays. Not documented means that page does not state the fact. Rows are alphabetical by product. 402Sentinel is included as retired.
attribution: The Agent Economy pre-payment checks (https://theagenteconomy.si/data/agent-prepayment-checks.json), licensed under CC BY 4.0.
inclusion: A row is included when the tool's own page describes a check before an agent pays a 402 endpoint or screens the wallet it would pay. Build experiments without that page are left out. 402Sentinel stays because its readme documents the retired hosted check and says the package can make x402 payments. Cells quote the linked page.
title: Agent pre-payment checks compared

sanctions.text: compliance_check is described as a pre pay screen whose hard block is an OFAC sanctions match.

payto_catalogue.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The README does not compare payTo with a seller catalogue. It says the firewall catches a payTo swapped against the address the agent usually pays.

price_sanity.text: The firewall is described as catching an overcharge on the payment the agent is about to make.

uptime.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The README does not state an uptime check.

identity_binding.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The README does not name ERC-8004 or another identity binding for the payee.

reputation.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The README scores settlement behaviour and a delivery outcome flywheel. It does not name a reputation check.

verdict.text: The README returns allow, review, or block. It also tells the caller to treat block and deny as do not pay.

failure_mode.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The README does not say whether a missed call fails open or fails closed.

signed_verdict.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The README does not say the allow, review, or block decision is signed. verify_service can return a signed credential for a seller audit, which is a different call.

networks.text: Settlement behaviour in the README is on Base, and paid calls use USDC through exact EIP-3009 on Base.

price.text: Paid calls cost from $0.002 to $0.02. assess_counterparty, recommend_policy, and firewall are $0.002. The deep, asset, and compliance calls are $0.02. report_outcome, firewall_record, and firewall_outcome are free.

license.text: package.json sets the license field to MIT, and the README ends with MIT.

status.text: package.json says the hosted service was retired on 2026-10-31. The README says the package can make x402 payments, the domain lapses in May 2027, and version 0.9.0 refuses 402sentinel.com.

sanctions.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The attest_guard page does not name a sanctions list.

payto_catalogue.text: The tool page says a verdict can name a wallet mismatch versus the verified payout wallet. It does not name a seller catalogue.

price_sanity.text: The tool page says a verdict can name price swaps versus the last verified quote.

uptime.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The attest_guard page does not state an uptime check.

identity_binding.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The attest_guard page does not name ERC-8004 or another identity binding.

reputation.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The attest_guard page does not name a reputation check.

verdict.text: The tool page says the verdict is allow, warn, or block.

failure_mode.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The tool page and the package README do not say whether a missed call fails open or fails closed.

signed_verdict.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The tool page does not say the verdict is signed.

networks.text: The tool page says network is a chain identifier from the offer, and its examples are base and solana.

price.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The package README says the client holds no account and no API key. It does not state a price for a scan.

license.text: The package README says the client package is MIT. Grading runs on Attest's servers and is not in the package.

status.text: The package README presents the hosted MCP server at attestagent.org/api/mcp as available. It does not apply a beta or retired label.

sanctions.text: The service description screens the US Treasury OFAC SDN list of digital currency addresses, and it also screens the ScamSniffer phishing address list.

payto_catalogue.text: The service description includes a CDP x402 Bazaar catalog snapshot and flags whether the address is an x402 payee in that snapshot.

price_sanity.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The service description does not state a price check.

uptime.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The service description does not state an uptime check.

identity_binding.text: The service description resolves ENS .eth names and Basenames. It does not name ERC-8004.

reputation.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The service description does not name a reputation check.

verdict.text: The service description returns one decision: ok, caution, or block.

failure_mode.text: The limits list says the check fails closed: if a check the verdict depends on does not complete, the verdict is at least caution and is never ok. Paid tiers then answer 503 and are not charged.

signed_verdict.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The service description does not say the verdict is signed.

networks.text: The chains list is Base, Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum One, and Solana.

price.text: The preview and the remote MCP tool are free, with a limit of 10 requests a minute per IP. Paid tiers are lite at $0.005, quick at $0.015, and full at $0.05, in USDC.

license.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The service description names GPL-3.0 for the ScamSniffer address list. It does not name a license for the CounterpartyCheck service.

status.text: The service description presents the free preview and the paid routes as available, and it names engine counterpartycheck-0.1.1. It does not apply a beta or retired label.

sanctions.text: The wrapper readme says payTo is an exact match against the US OFAC list of digital currency addresses, and the answer includes the sanctions list version.

payto_catalogue.text: The wrapper readme says Factline records payTo wallets listed in the Coinbase x402 Bazaar and the Circle x402 catalogue. A known seller asking for an unlisted wallet gets review, or deny in strict mode.

price_sanity.text: The wrapper readme checks the amount against the seller's lowest listed price and against the caller's budget.

uptime.text: The wrapper readme includes Factline's nightly uptime probes, and the agents page also names age and uptime.

identity_binding.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The wrapper readme does not name ERC-8004 or another identity binding.

reputation.text: The wrapper readme reports paying wallets, calls in the last 30 days, and payers left after removing self payments. It does not call that history a reputation check.

verdict.text: The wrapper readme says the answer is allow, review, or deny.

failure_mode.text: The wrapper readme says failOpen defaults to true, so a payment proceeds when the guard cannot be reached. Strict mode sets failOpen to false and aborts the payment.

signed_verdict.text: The wrapper readme says every answer includes an Ed25519 signed verdict. The signature covers a JSON string with the decision, seller origin, payTo, amount, mode, list version, and time.

networks.text: The wrapper example registers the client on eip155:8453. The readme does not list every network the guard can check.

price.text: The agents page calls the pay guard free. The changelog entry of 2026-10-14 also calls it free.

license.text: The wrapper readme says MIT licence.

status.text: The changelog lists the pay guard on 2026-10-14 and a catalogue and signature update on 2026-10-20. The agents page still documents the check. Neither page applies a retired label.

sanctions.text: The facilitator screen returns block for an OFAC sanctioned payer or payee. A separate wallet risk call also screens OFAC. The free endpoint monitor names uptime, price, and payout wallet.

payto_catalogue.text: The quickstart says a swapped payout wallet is denied when the 402 names a wallet the monitor has not seen this seller use.

price_sanity.text: The quickstart example denies a payment when the amount is higher than the monitored price.

uptime.text: The features page says every monitored endpoint is checked every 30 minutes, including uptime.

identity_binding.text: The features page describes optional agent credentials that tell a seller the agent belongs to a verified company. It does not name ERC-8004 for the payee.

reputation.text: The features page grades an endpoint from uptime, response time, price and wallet stability, and paid delivery. It does not call that grade a reputation check.

verdict.text: The free check returns allow or deny. Paid authorization returns allow, deny, or review. The features page also maps letter grades to proceed, caution, or avoid.

failure_mode.text: The features page says the SDK wrapper fails closed if PayCheck cannot be reached. The quickstart says that if PayCheck cannot be reached, do not pay.

signed_verdict.text: Paid allow includes an Ed25519 signed receipt bound to the URL, amount, and payout wallet. The features page also says each paid test produces an Ed25519 signed receipt.

networks.text: The plans page says the payments it prices in USDC are on Base or Solana.

price.text: Endpoint checks are free. Builder is $9 a month and Business is $49 a month. The facilitator plan includes 10,000 checks a month, then $1.50 per 1,000 checks.

license.text: The repository README says the documentation, examples, and packages in the repository are MIT licensed. The hosted service is not covered by that license.

status.text: The plans page offers free checks and paid plans. It does not apply a beta or retired label.

sanctions.text: The wallet screening page says a screen covers sanctions, exploits, phishing, scams, and mixer exposure. The example label is Sanctioned address.

payto_catalogue.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The wallet screening page does not compare an address with a seller catalogue.

price_sanity.text: The data services page says screen_transfer asks whether a stated amount of an asset can be sent, and it returns allow, review, or block. The wallet screening page itself does not name a price check.

uptime.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The wallet screening page does not state an uptime check.

identity_binding.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The data services page does not name ERC-8004 or another payee identity binding.

reputation.text: The wallet screening page returns a risk band, labels, exposure, and references. It does not call that band a reputation check.

verdict.text: The wallet page example shows a recommended action of Block. The data services page says screen_transfer returns allow, review, or block.

failure_mode.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The data services page does not say whether a missed call fails open or fails closed.

signed_verdict.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The data services page does not say the screen result is signed.

networks.text: The data services page lists Ethereum, BNB Smart Chain, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, and Avalanche for addresses and transactions.

price.text: The wallet screening page says the free tier is 10 lookups a day, with a work email and no card. A paid plan price is absent from that page and from the data services page.

license.text: The data services page says output is licensed for use inside your own product, with no resale. It does not name a software license identifier.

status.text: The wallet screening page offers the free tier. It does not apply a beta or retired label.

sanctions.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The README does not name a sanctions list.

payto_catalogue.text: The README says the guard checks that the payee the client selected matches the endpoint that was preflighted. It does not name a seller catalogue.

price_sanity.text: The README includes price sanity in the verdict, and the guard README adds an optional max_price_usd ceiling on the price being signed.

uptime.text: The README includes continuous uptime history in the verdict.

identity_binding.text: The README includes ERC-8004 identity binding. The guard README can require a bound identity.

reputation.text: The README includes Sybil filtered on chain reputation in the verdict.

verdict.text: The README rolls the checks into a proceed, caution, or avoid recommendation.

failure_mode.text: The guard README says fail_open defaults to true, so an unreachable service allows the payment with a warning. Setting it to false blocks the payment.

signed_verdict.text: Not documented as of 2026-11-09. The README does not say the trust-preview.v1 verdict is signed.

networks.text: The README layout names chain verifiers for EVM on Base and for SVM on Solana.

price.text: The README says the whole service is free and there is no paywall.

license.text: The guard README says MIT, and the service README shows an MIT license badge.

status.text: The README says the service is live at preflight402.ironshell.io and in the MCP registry as io.ironshell/preflight402.
